parameters.content:
### {{CLINIC_NAME}} - Lab Results Processing & Notification System (PET WF12)

**🎯 Purpose:** Automatically process incoming lab results, parse data, and deliver targeted notifications to veterinarians and clients

**🚀 Key Features:**

**Smart Result Processing:**
• **Email Monitoring:** Continuous monitoring of lab results email inbox
• **Intelligent Parsing:** Advanced pattern matching for various lab formats
• **Data Extraction:** Extracts patient ID, pet name, owner, test details, and urgency
• **Status Classification:** Categorizes results as Normal, Attention, or URGENT
• **Multi-Format Support:** Handles different lab result formats and structures

**Automated Notifications:**
• **Veterinarian Alerts:** Immediate email notifications with detailed HTML reports
• **Urgent SMS:** Critical results trigger immediate SMS alerts to vet
• **Client Communication:** Normal results automatically notify pet owners via SMS
• **Multi-Channel Delivery:** Email + SMS for urgent cases, targeted notifications otherwise
• **Professional Formatting:** Branded emails with clear result summaries

**Comprehensive Tracking:**
• **Results Database:** All lab results logged to Google Sheets
• **Notification Status:** Tracks what notifications were sent and when
• **Audit Trail:** Complete record of processing and communication
• **Status Updates:** Real-time tracking of notification delivery
• **Search & Filter:** Easy access to historical lab results

**⚡ Workflow Process:**

**Processing Flow:**
1. **Email Monitoring:** Continuous monitoring of lab results inbox
2. **Data Parsing:** Extract key information using intelligent pattern matching
3. **Classification:** Determine urgency level and result status
4. **Database Logging:** Store complete result details in tracking sheet
5. **Vet Notification:** Send detailed email report to veterinarian
6. **Urgency Check:** Evaluate if immediate SMS alert is needed
7. **Client Communication:** For normal results, notify owner via SMS
8. **Status Update:** Mark notifications as sent with timestamps

**🔍 Smart Parsing Features:**
• **Multi-Pattern Recognition:** Handles various lab result formats
• **Field Extraction:** Patient ID, pet name, owner, test type, results
• **Urgency Detection:** Automatically identifies critical/urgent results
• **Date Processing:** Extracts and formats test dates properly
• **Error Handling:** Graceful handling of incomplete or malformed data

**📊 Result Categories:**
• **Normal:** Standard results, client notification via SMS
• **Attention:** Abnormal results requiring vet review
• **URGENT:** Critical results requiring immediate action

**🔔 Notification Matrix:**
• **Normal Results:** Vet email + Client SMS
• **Attention Results:** Vet email only
• **URGENT Results:** Vet email + Urgent SMS to vet

**🔄 Integration Points:**
• Lab Results Hub: {{LAB_RESULTS_SHEET_ID}}
• Email Monitoring: {{LAB_EMAIL_CREDENTIAL_ID}}
• Veterinarian: {{VET_EMAIL}} / {{VET_PHONE}}
• Client Communication: {{CLIENT_PHONE}}
• Business Contact: {{BUSINESS_EMAIL}} / {{BUSINESS_PHONE_NUMBER}}

**⚙️ Configuration:**
• Clinic: {{CLINIC_NAME}}
• Lab Results Sheet: {{LAB_RESULTS_SHEET_NAME}}
• Timezone: {{TIMEZONE}}
• Brand Color: {{CLINIC_COLOR}}
• Admin Notifications: {{ADMIN_EMAIL}}
